children.value: > Fact From Story: Here he scored his fifth and sixth goals of the season. Previously he has never got more than seven.
> > Fact From Story: Erik ten Hag (right) and Mitchell van der Gaag, his assistant, talk tactics during the game.

> > Fact From Story: Partly from the fact that opponents have still not quite cottoned on to McTominay’s goal threat, those late runs to the far post, the blur on the edge of the 18-yard box that you don’t spot until it’s too late.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Coaches often talk to players about tactics that will improve their play.
> Fact From Story: McTominay is now United's top scorer for the season with six goals, one ahead of Bruno Fernandes and Rasmus Hojlund.
> > Fact From Story: United got themselves back to winning ways thanks to a superb Scott McTominay brace against Chelsea.

> > Fact From Story: The victory remarkably puts them within three points of rivals Manchester City, after the reigning champions were defeated by Aston Villa, and keeps them in reach of the top four places.
> > > > Fact From Story: United got themselves back to winning ways thanks to a superb Scott McTominay brace against Chelsea.
> > > > Commonsense Knowledge: Scoring is an important part of winning a soccer game.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Being the top scorer on a team that is winning games is a sign of success.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Therefore, McTominay is playing very well recently.
